editorial.blurb: One of Chicago's best sushi bars, Sushi Tokoro delivers fresh, carefully prepared Japanese cuisine with attentive service and some of the city's best all-you-can-eat pricing.
editorial.insiderTip: Go for their all-you-can-eat lunch at $19.95 and order the yaki iika, squid and tofu nigiri, and spider rolls—the checklist ordering system makes it easy to explore their large menu without missing standouts.
